title: Diffusion From Scratch — DDPM + DDIM + Classifier-Free Guidance + FID

modules.dataset: Image dataset builder for MNIST/CIFAR-10/synthetic geometric shapes (10 classes: circle, square, triangle, star, cross, hexagon, diamond, heart, arrow, ellipse). Normalized to [-1, 1]. PyTorch DataLoader.
modules.model: Complete diffusion engine: (a) NoiseScheduler (linear & cosine schedules with precomputed alpha bars); (b) UNet Denoiser (sinusoidal time embeddings, ResNet blocks, multi-head self-attention, class embeddings with null-token dropout); (c) DDPM Sampler (T-step stochastic); (d) DDIM Sampler (accelerated deterministic); (e) Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG scale w); (f) FID Calculator (Frechet distance via matrix sqrt).
modules.train: argparse CLI: trains DDPM with MSE noise loss, generates image grids via DDPM+DDIM, evaluates FID, saves checkpoint. Supports --dataset, --timesteps, --schedule, --base-ch, --generate, --checkpoint-out.
modules.tests: 11 tests: forward noising alpha-bar limits (x_T ≈ N(0,I)), alpha-bars monotonic decrease (linear + cosine), DDIM vs DDPM output shape parity, CFG w=1 → guided=conditional, CFG w=0 → guided=unconditional, UNet input-output shape match, UNet works without class labels, FID same=0, FID different>0, CLI smoke.
